SharedNodeMemory

Memory that is shared among all ranks on a single node. Must be enabled with the compilation flags -DUSE_MPI and -DUSE_SHARED_MEM (see Compilation).  reasonably recent linux kernel + headers required (memfd); as well as the uthash.h library somewhere in your CPATH.
